revisions.body:
# Heart Rush workspace

This repo contains the Heart Rush rules and the Next.js digital rulebook, including GM content and the Alaria world wiki. `map/` is a separate repository; keep it outside this app's build and Grove instances.

- For local development or isolation, read [[heart-rush/dev]]; use the development CLI's live help rather than hardcoding ports.
- Before editing rules, races, talents, or spells, read [[heart-rush-tools/authoring/rules]] because Heart Rush is not D&D and has its own mechanics and balance references.
- Before changing Alaria lore or geography, read [[heart-rush-tools/authoring/alaria]] and [[heart-rush-tools/authoring/atlas]] because content placement and regional consolidation are deliberate.
- Before editing combined Markdown, compiler code, navigation configs, or exports, read [[heart-rush-tools/content-pipeline]] because generated books can overwrite hand edits and unlisted books still appear under “Other”.
- When touching app routes or layout navigation, read [[heart-rush-tools/app-context]] because world, GM, and player contexts must stay consistent.

`pnpm run build` compiles content and builds the app; `pnpm run lint` checks the app's lint rules. Review generated tracked-file changes after compilation rather than treating every `all_sections_formatted/` file as hand-authored.

revisions.body:
# Heart Rush workspace

This repo contains the Heart Rush rule sources, GM content, and Alaria world wiki. The web workspace has TanStack Start apps under `apps/rules`, `apps/tools`, and `apps/play`, with shared packages; the old root Next.js app is being replaced, not preserved.

- For local development or isolation, read [[heart-rush/dev]]; use the development CLI's live help rather than hardcoding ports.
- Before editing rules, races, talents, or spells, read [[heart-rush-tools/authoring/rules]] because Heart Rush is not D&D and has its own mechanics and balance references.
- Before changing Alaria lore or geography, read [[heart-rush-tools/authoring/alaria]] and [[heart-rush-tools/authoring/atlas]] because content placement and regional consolidation are deliberate.
- Before editing combined Markdown or migrating the content compiler, read [[heart-rush-tools/content-pipeline]] because generated books can overwrite hand edits and the old navigation's omissions do not hide books.

Preserve the Markdown sources and race images. The old app's routes, provider arrangement, navigation UI, maps UI, and PDF implementation are not requirements for the new apps. Use the package scripts and live CLI help belonging to the current workspace rather than assuming the old Next.js commands still apply.
revisions.rationale: The concurrent approved TanStack rebuild replaced the root workspace; do not steer its agents toward preserving the old app.

why_it_exists: Replace always-loaded CLAUDE manuals with one small entry point and file-scoped authoring guidance.
